issues.title: As a stakeholder I wish to review a complex wargame
issues.body:
The players are planning a complex wargame that will run for several months.

The wargame includes many forces and players.

We should create a mock version of the wargame to help the players verify that Serge is meeting their requirement.

I have documented the forces/roles/channel membership here: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1WHCPC6rdqwVNYPQxUIoGfTWaBx0xEl-SjN05JrD6Dno/edit?usp=sharing

The wargame should also have these characteristics:
* name: `Papa Foxtrot`
* turn presentation: `Turn-pair-letters` (this is a new format: `0.a, 0.b, 1.a, 1.b`
* turn size: `Two months` (once we allow this in UI. For now we'll use a period of 60 days).

(please feel free to comment with questions)

comments.body:
@sanjayradadiya - one user is keen to see what messages sent via the COA template look like.  So, I know it won't be the "real" COA channel - but could you create the `COA` template in the repo, then add the `COA` template to the `Blue COA` channel please?  

Then they can:
* login as blue player
* build complex COA message
* go to admin
* export wargame 
* view CSV for COA messages 
* start writing code to parse/exploit COAs

Aah, actually @sanjayradadiya  now that the PR is merged we can create the `real` channels, with `real` participant attributes.

Please switch to the new strategy.  Thanks!
